mapper.sql: c.snapshot_id, c.document_id, c.version, d.title, d.version_date, d.applicable_scope, d.supersedes, d.content_hash AS document_hash, c.chunk_id, c.topic_key, c.content, c.start_offset, c.end_offset, c.content_hash
FROM kb_chunk c JOIN kb_document d USING (snapshot_id, document_id, version) JOIN kb_corpus s ON s.snapshot_id = c.snapshot_id AND s.state = 'READY'
c.snapshot_id COLLATE "C" ASC, c.document_id COLLATE "C" ASC, c.version COLLATE "C" ASC, c.chunk_id COLLATE "C" ASC
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM kb_corpus WHERE state = 'READY' ORDER BY published_at DESC, snapshot_id COLLATE "C" ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM kb_corpus WHERE snapshot_id = #{snapshotId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kb_corpus (snapshot_id, state, embedding_model, embedding_dimension, preprocessing_version, tokenizer_version, dictionary_version, stop_words_version, content_hash, created_at, published_at) VALUES (#{snapshot.snapshotId}, 'BUILDING', #{snapshot.indexProfile.embeddingModel}, #{snapshot.indexProfile.embeddingDimension}, #{snapshot.indexProfile.preprocessingVersion}, #{snapshot.indexProfile.tokenizerVersion}, #{snapshot.indexProfile.dictionaryVersion}, #{snapshot.indexProfile.stopWordsVersion}, #{snapshot.contentHash,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{snapshot.createdAt}, NULL)

INSERT INTO kb_document (snapshot_id, document_id, version, title, version_date, applicable_scope, supersedes, content, content_hash) VALUES
(#{doc.metadata.key.snapshotId}, #{doc.metadata.key.documentId}, #{doc.metadata.key.version}, #{doc.metadata.title}, #{doc.metadata.versionDate}, #{doc.metadata.applicableScope,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CAST(#{doc.metadata.supersedes,typeHandler=com.mango.backend.infra.pg.DocumentRefsTypeHandler} AS jsonb), #{doc.content}, #{doc.metadata.contentHash})

INSERT INTO kb_chunk (snapshot_id, document_id, version, chunk_id, topic_key, content, start_offset, end_offset, content_hash, search_vector, embedding) VALUES
(#{row.chunk.key.document.snapshotId}, #{row.chunk.key.document.documentId}, #{row.chunk.key.document.version}, #{row.chunk.key.chunkId}, #{row.chunk.topicKey}, #{row.chunk.content}, #{row.chunk.startOffset}, #{row.chunk.endOffset}, #{row.chunk.contentHash}, to_tsvector('simple'::regconfig, #{row.tokenText}), CAST(#{row.vector} AS vector))
mapper.select: SELECT document_id, version, content_hash FROM kb_document WHERE snapshot_id = #{snapshotId} ORDER BY document_id COLLATE "C" ASC, version COLLATE "C" ASC
SELECT count(*) FROM kb_chunk WHERE snapshot_id = #{snapshotId}
mapper.update: UPDATE kb_corpus SET state = 'READY', content_hash = #{contentHash}, published_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE snapshot_id = #{snapshotId} AND state = 'BUILDING'
mapper.select:
SELECT , ts_rank_cd(c.search_vector, q.query)::double precision AS raw_score
CROSS JOIN (SELECT
plainto_tsquery('simple'::regconfig, #{token})
AS query) q WHERE c.snapshot_id = #{snapshotId} AND c.search_vector @@ q.query ORDER BY raw_score DESC, LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT , 0.0::double precision AS raw_score
WHERE c.snapshot_id = #{snapshotId} AND (c.document_id, c.version, c.chunk_id) IN
(#{key.document.documentId}, #{key.document.version}, #{key.chunkId})
